g.text: D Changed-location attention trajectory at 30 degrees
VDA16 4x4 - crossattn1 - cue S1 top-left - 100% displayed validity
Paired checkpoint rerun: change at S1 versus forced change at S16; bands are 95% evaluation-trial intervals
Attention is summed over the changed location's image and recurrent-memory keys, then averaged over query tokens. Intervals describe finite trials from one checkpoint, not training-seed uncertainty.
